svg.title: Testing the claim that the rules are fixed
svg.desc: The will: A single person was to be honoured for recent work.. Current practice: Several individuals may share an award for an older discovery.. A precedent: The Peace Prize can recognise an organisation.

g.text: Testing the claim that the rules are fixed
A single person was to be honoured for recent work.
Several individuals may share an award for an older discovery.
The Peace Prize can recognise an organisation.
